calibration.objective: Maximize balanced answerability accuracy; ties: unsupported rejection, complete gold evidence coverage, then lower threshold.
calibration.method: DEV inference once at threshold0; simulate only pass/refusal from minimum facet confidence. Engineer confirmed threshold does not change facets/ranking/source choices; all selected sources are identical whenever all facets pass.
calibration.test_policy: V1 TEST was observed during V1 engineering. Reused TEST is regression only. New audit questions were frozen before V2 results and withheld from implementation engineer; same project team, not externally independent.

provenance_note: Inherited V1 source hash appended during final reproducibility audit; byte-identical to the original pre-V2 snapshot recorded in audit_freeze.json. No settings, source, predictions or results changed.
